name: MCPJam
description: Tests and evaluates MCP servers and MCP apps for developers, with a playground, OAuth debugger, cross-client evals, and CI checks, via web app, npx inspector, CLI, and SDK.

skills.name: Server Inspection
skills.description: Probes, diagnoses, and exports MCP server connectivity and capabilities, and lists or calls tools, resources, and prompts from the CLI.

skills.name: OAuth Conformance
skills.description: Tests an MCP server's OAuth across protocol versions with Dynamic Client Registration, pre-registration, and Client ID Metadata Documents.

skills.name: Cross-Model Evals
skills.description: Runs test cases with expected tool calls across multiple LLMs and tracks accuracy over time to catch MCP server regressions.

skills.name: CI Pipeline Checks
skills.description: Runs MCP health checks, conformance suites, and evals on every pull request in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and other CI systems.
